Sports data pipeline · Statistical decision engine

LockInModel

A fantasy-basketball tool that turns NBA game logs, schedules, and career statistics into explainable LOCK or WAIT recommendations.

  • Retrieves and normalizes box scores, career priors, and remaining schedules into configurable fantasy-point features.
  • Uses exponential recency weighting, career-prior shrinkage, and small-sample variance guards instead of a black-box classifier.
  • Exports diagnostic logs and CSV windows so every recommendation can be traced back to its inputs and probability calculation.

Python · Pandas · NumPy · nba_api · probability modelling · CSV diagnostics
